title: Parcel Customs in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **New on 1 November 2026:** a **€2 EU handling fee** per kind of goods on online orders from outside the EU, on top of the **€3 flat duty** that started on 1 July for orders up to €150.
**VAT still applies:** 19%, or 7% on books and most food, and it is charged on the value plus the duty and fee.
**Gifts are free up to €45** per parcel from one private person to another. Between €45 and €700 a **flat 17.5%** covers duty and tax.
**The carrier adds its own fee:** €7.50 at Deutsche Post. A €22 order with two kinds of goods can cost about **€23.58 extra**.
**At the Zollamt, the clock is short:** parcels wait **9 days**, letters 7, and the time can start before your notice arrives.
**My move:** check the shop's checkout for duties before you pay, and if a notice lands, email the office on it and ask for Postabfertigung von zu Hause.
